Thanks all — tally below and next steps: 

Votes: Vanessa = Yes, Tessa = Yes, Marissa = Hold (counts as Hold).
Scorecards: collected (see attachments).

Because we don't have unanimous Yes, I'm proposing two options and asking for a quick preference reply (one word):

A) Short follow-up interview (30 min) focused on distributed caching + cache invalidation exercise; target next week. If Marissa remains Hold after that, we will escalate to a quick sync to align.
B) Move forward with offer at IC3 Sr. SWE with a 90-day technical onboarding plan that includes targeted mentoring and a short design exercise in week 2.

Please reply with either "A" or "B" by EOD Monday (2026-04-12). If no reply, I'll default to A so we get more data.

Recruiter Ops (cc): if option B is chosen, can you draft an initial offer template with target comp band and start-date flexibility? If option A, please hold on offer drafting until we confirm.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turn.
